activation_semantics: An empty Document.AudioBuses array is the legacy implicit direct-master graph and requires no route or bus gain/pan capability. Any non-empty array activates the explicit single-parent graph and requires gain, pan, and route capabilities even for identity values.
cancellation_semantics: Every public evaluation requires context.Context. Cancellation is checked before and after each provider call, between block samples, and during bus summation; cancellation returns AUDIOGRAPH.V1.CANCELED and no partial Evaluation or BlockEvaluation.
channel_binding_semantics: Without a matrix, only exact mono layout with decoder order [FC] or exact stereo layout with [FL,FR] is accepted; mono duplicates to stereo. An authored matrix must exactly match ProbeManifest channel_layout, channel count, and decoder token order, and emits exact stereo sums before clip gain and pan.
failure_semantics: Compile returns no Program after any schema, capability, media-binding, source-profile, extension-consumer, or limit error. Runtime rejects provider request/domain/profile/resource/stream/scope mismatches and returns no partial success after provider, sample, time, cancellation, or DSP failure. Block output omits per-sample receipts to keep memory bounded but every sample passed the same strict response validation path.
limit_semantics: Before canonicalization or evaluator compilation, conservatively bound the complete typed Document graph by nodes/encoded bytes, all tracks/clips, and each ProbeManifest by streams/nodes/encoded bytes; exact canonical Document/manifest bytes are checked again before decode. Compile also bounds bindings, timelines, audio tracks and buses. Runtime bounds block sample count, platform allocation size, decoder channels, and numerator-plus-denominator bit length at source and every DSP/summation stage boundary; excess returns a stable limit error.
limiter_semantics: Only an explicitly authored master cutly.audio.limiter.sample-peak-instant.v1 stage runs, after master gain and pan. It is exact, stereo-linked, instantaneous, stateless, zero-lookahead, zero-latency sample-peak limiting; omission means no limiter.
pan_semantics: For exact pan p in [-1,1], left gain is min(1,1-p) and right gain is min(1,1+p). Stereo channels are balanced independently with no crossfeed; the same law applies after each bus gain.
rounding_semantics: Matrix, gain, pan, summation, and limiter arithmetic perform no rounding or PCM quantization. Output remains exact rational stereo until a separately versioned output profile.
source_provider_boundary: For every active clip, issue one versioned request binding the frozen canonical Document hash; complete timeline/track/clip/asset IDs and indexes; asset kind; exact timeline/local/source times; selected immutable ProbeManifest fingerprint, resource hash/size and stream; decoder channel tokens; and binding-frozen decode, selection and retime profiles. The provider must exactly echo the request plus the ordered-channel source domain. The graph validates every field against a provider-isolated request copy and retains a defensive SourceReceipt before DSP. A receipt records validated claims and exact returned channels; it is not a signature or proof that an untrusted provider actually followed them.
source_sample_domain: Provider input is cutly.audio.sample.exact-rational-ordered-channels.v1 in the exact DecoderChannels order and may contain one, two or an explicitly matrix-bound larger channel set. Graph output is cutly.audio.sample.exact-rational-stereo.v1. All values are bounded arbitrary-precision rationals in nominal full-scale units; values outside [-1,1] are valid and no implicit clamp, normalization, saturation or fallback is applied.
summation_semantics: For each bus, direct active track signals are summed in selected-timeline track-array order, then child-bus outputs are summed in Document.AudioBuses order. Exact arithmetic does not authorize an implementation to reorder the evidence trace.
